$description: Semantic radius tier (mode-independent). --mf-radius is the base; sm/md/lg/xl derive from it. mod-core/gui/.ladle/styles.css defines these as calc(var(--radius) * k). DTCG has no calc primitive, so each derived token carries BOTH the pre-computed literal $value (so the compiled default matches today's render exactly) AND the multiplier in $extensions, letting task 002 choose to emit calc(var(--mf-radius) * k) instead — which is preferable so a runtime --mf-radius override cascades to the derived steps. See tokens/README.md.
